_comment: Stage 2 draft for Prisoners (2013) recap. Each line binds narration to an exact shot from shots.json (clip_start/clip_end must match a catalogued entry). Lines L02+ run in source-film time order; only unit U01 (narrative_jump hook) may jump. Tone: measured, suspenseful, descriptive - footage carries the weight. Holly is never framed as a villain before U17. claim.requires_visual lists the on-screen elements the line asserts (must be present in the bound clip's chars/action). MAX_REUSE per clip = 2, MAX_FAMILY_USES = 2.

lines.narration: A quiet Pennsylvania town. A Thanksgiving meal between two families. And then two little girls walked out the front door and never came back.

lines.narration: I'm Serabudabu, and today we'll be reviewing Prisoners, twenty-thirteen - Denis Villeneuve's psychological thriller that asks how much a person will sacrifice to find what they've lost.
